newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.

text.p: Robert Fleming & Co Ltd said Tuesday it was reiterating its buy rating on Brazilian federal telecom holding Telebras .

-- Flemings analysts William Laurent and Ronald Aitken said in a report the Communications Ministry was likely to recommend Telebras be split into three companies plus long- distance unit Embratel for privatization.

-- "The three companies would be Telesp, possibly with Teleamazon; Telepar and all areas in the country's north and west of the cuntry; and Telemig, Telerj and Telebahia together with eight northeastern telcos," they wrote.
-- The recommendations are not final and the ministry is expected to appoint advisors to make recommendations, but the privatization is expected to be completed by June 1998, they added.
-- The creation of three large holding companies could mean that existing quoted telecoms such as Telemig and Telerj would still be quoted separately, Laurent and Aitken said.
-- "Telebras shares would simply be split into three new shares, one for each regional holding, one for each regional holding," they wrote.
-- Telebras' ADR closed off 1\07 at 125\05 in New York, while its preferred fell 2.16 percent to end at 136.00 reais and its common closed down 1.53 percent at 122.50 reais in Sao Paulo.
